unlisted_practices: Design principles for a caregiver-support chatbot: personalized assessment, transparent information, role awareness support, accessibility, and continuous companionship
Reflective prompts to support caregivers in recognizing and re-evaluating their role
Recommending personalized support resources to informal caregivers

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates user experience and design requirements for an AI companion chatbot supporting informal caregivers using think-aloud sessions and interviews, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparatively.
